narrative.details:
<Advisor Belgrum reaches the end of the note, and his eyes widen for a moment.>

Och, these are evil tidings.

adventurer, please return to Historian Karnik and tell him on the king's authority to act on this information swiftly and decisively. He must halt the Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You're treating this matter with an urgency I'd expect from the king himself, adventurer.

All right, then. I know what'll bring the Shadowforge down.

Their presence in Uldaman can be slowed if we strike them at their base of operations: Angor Fortress.

quests.name: Prospect of Faith
quests.objectiveText: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

quests.name: Passing Word of a Threat
quests.objectiveText: Find Advisor Belgrum and give him his note.

quests.name: An Ambassador of Evil
quests.objectiveText: Kill Ambassador Infernus in Angor Fortress and bring proof of his death to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Will
quests.objectiveText: Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
